request.style: English, female voice, soft and reverent, solo with choir, piano, strings, ambient pad, warm and intimate, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I bow my knees before the Father
Who names every family in heaven
Every kin on earth is known to Him
From the depths of this world

[Chorus]
Christ may dwell in your hearts
Through faith, the root is deep
Grounded in love, we are made strong
With power through His Spirit

[Verse]
Out of the riches of His glory
He grants us strength within
Not by our own might or hand
But by the Spirit within

[Chorus]
Christ may dwell in your hearts
Through faith, the root is deep
Grounded in love, we are made strong
With power through His Spirit

[Bridge]
Wide and long and high and deep
We grasp the love of Christ
Surpassing knowledge, filled with God
Beyond all we can imagine

[Outro]
Filled with the fullness of God
Christ dwell in your hearts
